newsitem.title: USA: FSA announces secondary market insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA announces secondary market insurance.

text.p: FSA announces that it is reducing the premium for New York City GO.
FSA announces that it is offering secondary market insurance capacity for:
New York State U.D.C. (Correctional Facilities only)
New York State Dorm Authority (State University System)

New York State Dorm Authority (City University System) There is no capacity limit per firm. Insurance is available on maturities 2007 and longer. For further details, please contact Tom Byrne, Greg Haggerty, or Alan Steinfeld at 212-826-0601.
